card.desc:
# Bad Company Patch

- Unit pilot range tripled!
- ATTENTIONNN is now a hold variant of Maneuver.
- New base move: Flanking
- New base move: Landmine
- New EX move: Airstrike
- Paratroopers is now an EX skill and can drop ANY unit type, not just infantry.
- Lowered unit health across the board:
  Infantry 30 to 10
  Green Berets 24 to 5
  Tanks 60 to 45
  Helicopters 36 to 15
- Each unit type has its own differing replacement cooldown:
  Infantry 10s
  Green Berets 16s
  Tanks 25s
  Helicopters 30s
- Tank shellsare perfect blockable (they still GB)
- Helicopter missiles can now be blocked
- Shells and Missiles flash a warning right before they fire.
- Helicopters fly slightly lower
- Piloted Infantry and Green Berets move 50% faster, piloted helicopters move twice as fast
- Enemies can dash twice to throw off Green Berets
- The unit menu can now be moved via HUD layout editor
- Completely redid the alt colors for every unit and now are the following:
  Urban
  Special Forces
  Desert
  ——————

Crazy Diamond wall creation is not cancelled by stun.
3rd Gang Plot added.
card.name: 24/11/2026 (Bad Company Rework)
